1.title: Hello World
1.description: Write a Python program that prints 'Hello, World!'

2.title: Sum Two Numbers
2.description: Write a Python program that sums 3 and 5 and prints the result.
2.hint: Use addition and print the result.

3.title: Sum of Even Numbers
3.description: Write a Python program that sums all even numbers from 1 to 10 and prints the result.
3.hint: Use a for loop and the modulo (%) operator to check for even numbers.

4.title: Multiplication Table
4.description: Print the multiplication table of 5 from 1 to 5.
4.hint: Use a for loop and multiplication.

5.title: Check Even or Odd
5.description: Check if 7 is even or odd and print 'Even' or 'Odd'.
5.hint: Use the modulo operator (%) and an if statement.

7.title: Sum of List
7.description: Sum all numbers in the list [1, 2, 3, 4, 5] and print the result.
7.hint: Use a loop or sum() function.

8.title: Print Squares
8.description: Print squares of numbers from 1 to 5, one per line.
8.hint: Use a for loop and exponentiation (**).

10.title: Simple Function
10.description: Define a function that returns the square of 6 and print the result.
10.hint: Define a function using def and return the square.
